cim: Windsor Library To Offer Introductory Artificial Intelligence Class
cim_eredeti: Windsor Library To Offer Introductory Artificial Intelligence Class
szoveg_eredeti:
Windsor Public Library will host “Discovering the Wonders of Artificial Intelligence” on Monday, Nov. 9, from 6:30 to 8:30 p.m., according to its event listing. Bert Sirkin will teach the introductory class, which covers AI's history, everyday benefits and chatbot uses.

The program is designed for older adults, though the library's listing includes both teens and adults. No technology expertise is needed. The Windsor Library Association sponsors the program.

The event page lists registration as required and sets a deadline of 6:30 p.m. Monday, Nov. 9, although the program description calls registration suggested. Readers can register on the event page. Questions about the program or registration can be directed to the Reference Desk at 860-285-1918.

Source: “Discovering the Wonders of Artificial Intelligence” (windsorfire.org)
